title: AUTHORIZE the Chief Executive Officer to award a 26-month, firm fixed price contract No. DR141438 to BAE Systems Controls, Inc. for 434 Generators and…
text:
[Metro Board file 2026-0608, Contract]
[OPERATIONS, SAFETY, AND CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE COMMITTEE MADE THE FOLLOWING RECOMMENDATION (5-0):]
AUTHORIZE the Chief Executive Officer to award a 26-month, firm fixed price contract No. DR141438 to BAE Systems Controls, Inc. for 434 Generators and Accessory Power System (APS) units to support the Bus Midlife Program on Metro 1505-1799 series El Dorado 40 ft buses for a total Not-To-Exceed (NTE) contract amount of $36,771,518 inclusive of sales tax; subject to the resolution of any properly submitted protest(s), if any.
summary: Metro would award BAE Systems Controls a 26-month contract of up to $36.8 million for 434 generator and auxiliary power units for the midlife overhaul of its 1505-1799 series El Dorado buses.
